data.one_liner: Generate random lorem ipsum text easily, quickly, and dynamically.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple function to generate customizable blocks of random lorem ipsum text. Supports configuring the number of words, paragraphs, and whether to start with the classic 'Lorem ipsum' phrase.
use_when: You need placeholder text for UI wireframes or prototypes
You are testing text-heavy widgets with dynamic content
avoid_when: You need real, localized content for a production user-facing application
strengths: Configurable paragraphs, word counts, and starting phrase
weaknesses: Very basic feature set with no advanced typography generation
